title: Residential Field Habits
short_answer: Less paper, more verbal — which is exactly why change-order discipline matters more on builder jobs, not less.
summary: Less paper, more verbal — which is exactly why change-order discipline matters more on builder jobs, not less.
plain_words: Residential sets are thinner. Questions often start as a phone call. Changes often sound casual. Our standard does not get casual: stop, photo, write, call. Lock box and window/garage notes on Job Start still govern day one.
when_to_use: Builder / residential jobs in OH, IN, or KY
When verbal adds or "normal for this builder" pressure shows up
First week on site before habits from the last subdivision take over
prerequisites: Job Start packet accepted and Handoff PDF read
Lead knows office contact for same-day escalation
stage_line: How we run jobs · builder work

steps.title: Job Start first
steps.body: Lock box, exclusions, window type/returns, garage finish, open questions — before layout or hang.

steps.title: Do not assume builder habit
steps.body: Do not assume "normal for this builder" when the packet or drawings say otherwise.

steps.title: Verbal adds
steps.body: Run the Change Order ten-minute drill the same day — stop, photo, write, call.

steps.title: Dimension convention
steps.body: Residential often faces framing — still read the note on each drawing; do not guess centerline vs face.

steps.title: Get answers in writing
steps.body: Even if the first contact was a call — texts that scroll away are not a record.

steps.title: Punch with the superintendent
steps.body: Use Punch List Cadence — drywall before paint.

warnings.title: Casual does not mean free
warnings.body: Residential jobs lose more margin to verbal adds performed and never billed than to bad hang quality. Documentation matters more when the process is informal.

quality_checks.prompt: Job Start fields read (lock box, exclusions, windows, garage, open questions) before production
Verbal adds get same-day stop-photo-write-call discipline
Answers captured in writing even when the first ask was a phone call

common_mistakes.title: Subdivision habit
common_mistakes.wrong: Build this job like the last builder's default
common_mistakes.right: Match this job's packet and drawings
common_mistakes.why: Repeat road names across three states — packet is the stand-behind source

common_mistakes.title: Casual verbal add
common_mistakes.wrong: "While you're here" work done as a favor
common_mistakes.why: Informal process needs stricter documentation, not looser

common_mistakes.title: Scrolling text as record
common_mistakes.wrong: Rely on a group text thread for scope answers
common_mistakes.right: Written answer in email, RFI, or office log
common_mistakes.why: Texts scroll away; notice windows do not
